IDAGIO is the leading streaming service for classical music, based in Berlin and part of IDAGIO Group. The Group spans streaming, recordings, and live music partnerships, globally. Our director initiates projects across all of it: recording partnerships with orchestras, licensing talks with international labels, concert-hall collaborations in Taiwan and Japan, and new ventures.
These initiatives move fast and span many time zones. We are looking for the person at the director's side who keeps them all on track.
Tasks
You are the assistant to the sole director of IDAGIO Group and work with him daily. He travels extensively and meets industry leaders, orchestras, and institutions across Asia, Europe and the US. Every trip produces introductions, ideas, and commitments. Your job is to make sure none of them get lost. You track every thread, follow up with every party, and hold everyone to agreed deadlines, including the director.
Beyond that, you coordinate selected projects across the Group's Berlin companies, working with their Managing Directors. Decisions sit with the director and the Managing Directors. Keeping things moving sits with you.
Assistant and project support to the director
Track and follow up on the projects and partnerships the director runs across the Group. You keep an up-to-date overview of status, owners, and next steps at all times.
Maintain deadlines and flag slipping dates early. You chase open items without being asked.
Prepare agendas, briefings, and follow-ups for meetings. Maintain trackers and status summaries.
Coordinate scheduling, information flow, and documentation across internal and external stakeholders, from orchestra managements to distribution partners.
Project coordination for Moto Lab
Moto Lab Partners is the Group's newest venture: it supports classical artists and institutions in building their international presence and careers, from recordings and concert videos to release strategy and promotion.
Coordinate Moto Lab's projects from start to finish, whatever their shape: a release, a concert video production, a marketing campaign, or a partner engagement.
Act as the central point of contact between everyone involved: artists and their management, orchestras, production crews, distributors, agencies, and internal teams.
Track each project's timeline from planning through delivery, follow up on deliverables, and support project and budget administration until everything is complete and approved.

Several years of professional experience, typically 2 to 5, in an assistant, coordination, project management, or artist management role. This should not be your first job. You have managed deadlines across multiple stakeholders and worked alongside a demanding senior principal before.
A firm understanding of classical music and the industry around it: repertoire, orchestras, how recordings and releases work. A background in classical music (studies, an orchestra, a label, an agency, a concert hall) is a strong plus.
Proactive and organized by temperament. You take ownership, chase without being prompted, and flag problems early.
Comfortable running several projects in parallel and prioritizing against deadlines.
Clear, structured communication and documentation. Status is transparent to everyone at any time.
Fluent German and English (C1 or better, spoken and written). Japanese or Mandarin is a real plus given our partners in Japan and Taiwan.
Based in Berlin or willing to relocate. Occasional flexibility for calls with Asia or the US and for concert or recording dates in the evening.

A rare vantage point: you work directly with the director of a music group active between Europe and Asia, and you see every initiative across it.
Real responsibility from day one. The role exists because these projects matter and need an owner.
A small, senior, international team in Berlin with short decision paths.
Salary range: €42,000–50,000 gross/year, depending on experience.
Send a short cover note, your CV, and your earliest possible start date to apply. Tell us about one person or project you supported where your follow-through made the difference.
IDAGIO and the IDAGIO Group value diversity. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements.

Für unsere Mandantin, ein erfolgreiches Schweizer Industrieunternehmen mit Hauptsitz im Raum Schaffhausen, suchen wir eine engagierte und technisch versierte Persönlichkeit als
# Projektleiter/in Technik / Industrie (m/w) #
In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion übernehmen Sie die selbstständige Planung, Koordination und Betreuung anspruchsvoller technischer Projekte und begleiten diese von der Anfrage bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung bzw. Serienreife.

Sie koordinieren die verschiedenen internen und externen Schnittstellen, überwachen Termine, Kosten sowie Projektfortschritte und stellen eine strukturierte und zielgerichtete Projektabwicklung sicher. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit Kunden sowie den Bereichen Entwicklung, Produktion, Qualität, Einkauf und weiteren Fachstellen zusammen.

Technische Abklärungen, das Erkennen möglicher Projektrisiken und die Einleitung entsprechender Massnahmen sowie eine transparente Projektdokumentation und ein regelmässiges Reporting gehören ebenfalls zu Ihrem abwechslungsreichen Aufgabengebiet.
Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische Grundausbildung, beispielsweise als Polymechaniker, Konstrukteur, Anlagen- und Apparatebauer, Kunststofftechnologe oder in einem vergleichbaren Beruf.

Idealerweise haben Sie sich technisch, betriebswirtschaftlich oder im Bereich Projektmanagement weitergebildet und konnten bereits Erfahrung in einem industriellen bzw. produzierenden Umfeld sammeln. Erfahrung in der Leitung oder Koordination technischer Projekte ist von Vorteil.

Gerne berücksichtigen wir auch ambitionierte technische Fach- oder Führungskräfte, welche den nächsten Karriereschritt in Richtung Projektleitung anstreben. Sie besitzen ein gutes Verständnis für technische und betriebliche Zusammenhänge und überzeugen mit einer selbstständigen, strukturierten und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise.

Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie gute IT-Anwenderkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab.
Suchen Sie eine neue Herausforderung als Projektleiter in einem erfolgreichen Industrieunternehmen mit technisch anspruchsvollen und renommierten Produkten? Erfüllen Sie das oben genannte Profil oder möchten Sie den nächsten Schritt in Richtung Projektleitung machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse und Diplome) an Roman Meister, roman.meister@evergreen-hr.ch.

Join us on our mission to help medical innovators bring life-saving products to market faster and safer.
About REMATIQ
REMATIQ builds AI software for life sciences and medical device companies. Our platform helps teams automate complex documentation and compliance workflows, while keeping outputs traceable, reviewable, and audit-ready.
Product development in MedTech is highly complex: teams need to manage requirements, documentation, quality processes, regulatory expectations, and internal reviews across many systems and stakeholders. REMATIQ helps customers simplify this work, reduce manual effort, and move faster without compromising on quality or compliance.
We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, have raised €5.4M in Seed funding, and are now preparing for our next stage of scale and growth as we move toward Series A.
We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week .

As a Delivery Manager at REMATIQ, you will independently drive customer projects from problem framing to successful delivery. You will work closely with customers, our leadership team, Forward Deployed Engineers, MedTech Domain Experts, Product, and Engineering to turn complex customer needs into high-quality AI-powered workflows.
This is a hands-on project ownership role. You should be savvy and comfortable working with AI, software, implementation topics, and complex regulated workflows, but you will not be expected to be the technical expert or the MedTech domain expert.

Own customer delivery workstreams: Structure ambiguous problems, define the workplan, align stakeholders, manage risks, and drive projects to successful outcomes.
Lead customer interactions: Work directly with customer project teams and subject-matter experts to understand their goals, workflows, constraints, pain points, and success criteria.
Bring structure and insight: Frame complex issues clearly, break them down into practical next steps, push for insight, and turn ambiguity into decisions.
Create high-quality outputs quickly: Produce project plans, meeting materials, workflow documentation, decision documents, customer-facing drafts, internal summaries, and scalable delivery templates.
Become fluent in the REMATIQ product: Demo it, explain it, teach it, support customers after rollout, capture feedback, and identify opportunities for additional use cases.
We are looking for a top performer with exceptional project ownership, analytical horsepower, customer presence, and execution speed.

Comfort with software and implementation topics: You are curious, fast-learning, and confident working with product, data, workflows, and AI-enabled solutions.

Fluency in English and German.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you'll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre service de contrôle d-accès, nous recherchons un(e) Chef de Projet pour piloter la mise en œuvre de nos solutions. A ce poste, vous serez responsable de la gestion complète des projets, depuis leur lancement jusqu-à leur finalisation, en veillant au respect des délais, des coûts et de la qualité. * Vous êtes responsable de la planification, du budget et de la qualité de l'exécution des projets.

* Vous êtes capable de prendre des décisions et de gérer efficacement plusieurs priorités dans un environnement complexe et évolutif.
* Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en coordination de parties prenantes variées.
